analysis: Use case: ui-mockup. High fidelity production mobile WEB screenshot for USED PICK price analysis, logical viewport390x844, flat screenshot no phone frame/no OS bars. User asks compact one-row checkbox/select controls and stock-site style enlargeable chart. True white #fff background, ink #182331, burnt orange #c94b26, subtle #e5e9ee divider, Korean system sans. Existing marketplace brand wordmark USED PICK at left of56px header, hamburger '메뉴' at right; no inline nav tabs/policies. Under header exactly ONE 44px row with 12px side gutters, 5px gaps: 1 model selector 'GTX 950 ⌄', 2 scope selector '국내 비교 ⌄', 3 price selector '판매중 ⌄', 4 square outline external-listings arrow icon with aria meaning 매물 보기 (icon not big text). Under this a stock-like but honest daily used-price line chart (NOT candlesticks, no trading/order widgets, no fake financial metrics). Chart occupies about310px, light horizontal grid, left axis35,000/45,000/55,000, bottom dates09.06/10.04/10.31. Three restrained lines blue Joonggonara, red Bunjang, brown Danawa; visible gaps not invented continuous observations. Very small '원' axis unit and small '점선: 기록 없음' if needed, no giant title or text paragraphs. Footer compact native toolbar + / - / reset / diagonal expand icon with 44px hit areas, neatly right aligned outside plot; actual interactive controls later. Below a one-line '최근 관측' readout/date header, then a compact open source comparison LIST with three plain white rows separated by subtle dividers, no big cards. Each about52px: native checkbox/check left, source name '중고나라', bold right-aligned '35,000원'; tiny second line '평균 · 8건 · 10.31' only where necessary; row2 번개장터40,625원; row3 다나와58,560원 with small '최저 표시가 참고 · 1건 · 10.30' semantic qualifier. Avoid data-filler, hero, card panels, large whitespace, pills. Compact readable11-15px labels, prices17px. Below useful content page can remain white; do not invent features just to fill. Exact source prices only illustrative mockup data; code uses real existing data. Everything implementable with HTML/CSS and actual daily line chart; compare model and price scope via radio selection sheets, no dashboard clutter. Styling coherent with compact USED PICK mobile marketplace.

builder: Use case: ui-mockup. Draw a high fidelity compact mobile WEBSITE screen for USED PICK '컴퓨터 시세', 390x844 logical viewport, tall portrait screenshot fills image, no device mockup, no OS bars, no slide annotations. Existing brand white#fff, dark#182331, accent burnt orange#c94b26, subtle gray dividers, Korean system sans. User wants densely useful but readable, simple rows, no huge top/bottom gaps. Match mobile USED PICK price analysis, avoid marketing copy. Header56px simple wordmark USED PICK plus hamburger 메뉴 right. Next short single44px row heading '컴퓨터 시세' left, text action '저장' and small more/options button right. Below a SINGLE42px price display control strip using native round check/radio indicators labels '판매중', '판매완료 표시가', '다나와'. 판매중 selected orange; others empty circles. This only controls which existing price column is visible, never adds currencies or changes calculations. Then plain compact PC-component list/table, all7 core rows fit before650px: CPU, 그래픽카드, RAM, 메인보드, SSD, HDD, 파워. Each row height60-68px, 12px gutters. Category width60 at left in small13px semibold; middle selected model title or a subtle '부품 선택 +' button, right small quantity field1 and discreet more icon only for populated rows. For selected parts show bold actual-price-text14px right aligned in same row, long model can wrap to2lines; do not repeat '판매중 가격' per row. Illustrative selected entries: CPU 'Ryzen 5 5600' '120,000원', GPU 'RTX 4070' '740,000원', RAM 'DDR4 16GB' '32,000원', 메인보드 'B550' '85,000원', SSD '삼성 1TB' '65,000원'; HDD and 파워 empty show only 부품 선택 +, no empty price dashes, no blank subpanels. Quantity1 with slim44px touch target; row changes open check selection sheet; no giant grid cards. Thin horizontal dividers between rows. A concise footer aligned under same table, label '부분 합계' left and large22px dark '1,042,000원' right; small muted '5개 부품 가격 반영' only because missing components make total partial. One compact preserved safety/help link '호환성 확인' if an actual warning exists; no invented green success claim. No advertising art in concept, no unnecessary repeated explanation. Row prices and total are illustrative and code must retain real data. Below this leave modest whitespace rather than filler; compact and practical. Preserve clear touch actions and sane Korean typography; small visible plus/add buttons, sparse borders, NO shadows/gradients/pills/oversized rounded panels. Native code UI later, not a static image shipped to users.
